title: valerianoides orubica
intro: Valerianoides orubica, commonly known as  the red valerian, is a flowering plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The bioactive constituents of Valerianoides orubica include valepotriates, isovaleric acid, and sesquiterpene, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
